stories.title: AI capitalist China vs command-control US
stories.summary: China and the United States pursue contrasting approaches to artificial intelligence development. The US government leads with public resources and control, while China allows companies to innovate freely. China focuses on commercialising AI, making it widely accessible for industrial applications. The US faces deployment challenges as it imports many manufactured goods. Global AI commerce rules will likely reflect Chinese commercial values and priorities.
